description:
The Firmstrong Urban Man 7-Speed is a great choice for riders who want a little something extra from their cruiser bicycle. While it keeps the classic, trendy design that beach cruisers are known for, the seven speeds and handbrakes make this bike far more versatile than a standard model. It is particularly well-suited for tackling hills or embarking on long-distance rides of over 15 miles that might be too challenging for a single-speed bike. Optimized for riders up to 5'11", the frame geometry ensures a balanced, comfortable fit for standard heights.

At the core of the Urban Man 7-Speed is the Shimano gear system, widely considered the best seven-speed option for a cruiser. This system uses a derailleur to move the chain between different sprockets as you shift gears. Gear one is the easiest to pedal, making it ideal for going uphill or maintaining a slow, steady pace. Gear seven provides the most resistance, which is what you will use for high-speed riding and coasting downhill. These gears give the bike the functionality of a hybrid or mountain bike, yet you still get to enjoy the comfortable, upright riding position that makes cruisers so popular.

To manage the increased speed of this 7-speed model, we’ve equipped it with front and rear Tektro V-brakes. These handbrakes provide significantly more stopping power and precision control than a traditional coaster brake, which is essential for safely navigating descents or city traffic. The gear system also features a rear freewheel, so you can pedal backwards freely while riding without engaging the brakes. Whether you are looking to commute, get some exercise, or simply enjoy a longer journey, the Urban Man 7-Speed is a durable, practical upgrade for anyone who wants a classic cruiser look with the performance to go the distance.

19” Steel Frame with 26” Aluminum Wheels

7 Speed Shimano Bicycle has a wide range of gears for all types of riding; short rides, long distance and uphill riding

Front and Rear Handbrakes are easy to operate and provide great stopping power even on downhill rides

Dual Spring Oversized Seat for Added Comfort

2.125” Wide White-Wall Tires provides a cushioned, relaxed ride for easy rolling

28.5” Wide Cruiser Bike Handlebars with Thick Rubber Grips

Bicycle Weighs approximately 34.5 lbs. Fully Assembled

Fits Most Men 5’2” – 5’11” Tall

Recommended Riding Speed 3 – 30mph

Recommended Riding Distance 0 – 40 miles in a single trip

The Seat and Handlebar Height and Tilt can be adjusted to properly fit the rider

Color Matched Fenders can be Purchased Separately for $49.99.

Bike comes 85% Assembled, Assembly is easy and fun!

Designed in Hermosa Beach, CA.
